name: Account
definition: Record of transactions in specific types of assets, maintained by a servicing party on behalf of one or more owning parties. Business relationship between an account servicer and one or more account owners.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language for all communication concerning the account.

ReportingCurrency.name: Reporting Currency
ReportingCurrency.definition: Currency used to calculate and report the balance and related entries of an account.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Specifies the purpose of the account.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Date on which the account and related services cease effectively to be operational for the account owner.

LiveDate.name: Live Date
LiveDate.definition: Date of the first movement on the account.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Date on which the account and related basic services are effectively operational for the account owner.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

ParentAccount.name: Parent Account
ParentAccount.definition: Account for which one or more sub-accounts are specified.

SubAccount.name: Sub Account
SubAccount.definition: Subdivision of an account used to segregate specific holdings.

RelatedFundProcessingCharacteristics.name: Related Fund Processing Characteristics
RelatedFundProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Fund processing characteristics for which a settlement account is specified.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the current state of an account, eg, enabled or deleted.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to an account and played by a party in that context.

TradePartyRole.name: Trade Party Role
TradePartyRole.definition: Party for which an account is specified in the context of a trade.

AccountRestriction.name: Account Restriction
AccountRestriction.definition: Restriction on capability or operations allowed.

SettlementPartyRole.name: Settlement Party Role
SettlementPartyRole.definition: Specifies the role of the party which uses the account for settlement.

ReportedPeriod.name: Reported Period
ReportedPeriod.definition: Specifies the period for which the movements in the account are reported.

InvestmentFundPartyRole.name: Investment Fund Party Role
InvestmentFundPartyRole.definition: Party role for which an account is specified.

RelatedCollateralProcess.name: Related Collateral Process
RelatedCollateralProcess.definition: Collateral data for which a collateral account is specified.

RelatedProceedsDelivery.name: Related Proceeds Delivery
RelatedProceedsDelivery.definition: Proceeds delivery instruction which contain account identification.

RelatedCorporateActionPartyRole.name: Related Corporate Action Party Role
RelatedCorporateActionPartyRole.definition: Party for which an account is specified in the context of a corporate action.

DefaultFundAccountOwner.name: Default Fund Account Owner
DefaultFundAccountOwner.definition: Clearing member which holds a default fund account at an ICSD or at the central bank.

System.name: System
System.definition: System where the account is held.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Overall position representing the net debits and credits in an account at a specific point in time.

Entry.name: Entry
Entry.definition: Record of the movements into or out of an account.

AccountContract.name: Account Contract
AccountContract.definition: Agreement which provides information on the account and on the services linked to it.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Rate used to calculate the difference between amounts based on the base currency and the reporting currency.

DefaultFundContribution.name: Default Fund Contribution
DefaultFundContribution.definition: Default fund contribution parameters associated with a contribution account.

SystemMember.name: System Member
SystemMember.definition: Member of a system which is the owner of an account with the system.

AccountService.name: Account Service
AccountService.definition: Services linked to the account and specified in the account contract.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Process which compares and matches trade information with entries in an account.

ManagedAccountProduct.name: Managed Account Product
ManagedAccountProduct.definition: Product which provides guidance to investors to manage their portfolios.
